Search snippets were discovery aids only; retrieved primary text was preferred. No database or project runtime was executed.

## Scoped current-project source evidence

The coordinator and execution research worker independently sent narrow read-only source findings for `engine/ITERATION-02.md` and `engine/src/temporal_core.cpp`. This worker did **not** open those project files. They establish the current grammar/eager-filter constraints listed in REPORT.md only as coordinator-supplied source observations. The execution worker subsequently reviewed report sections 1/4/5/8 for agreement and reported the existing exact `Relation.seen` dictionary-ID tuple index, typed-domain maps, and arity bound. These are source-only observations, not runtime verification, item3 acceptance, remote-head verification, or measured performance.

## Retrieval limits and rejected inference

- Authors' chapter 5 repeatedly timed out; it is not relied on. Equivalent safety evidence was available from official Soufflé rules and the existing language's supplied source contract.
- Several web PDF screenshot requests returned cache misses. Parsed primary PDF text remained available. No equation was claimed visually checked.
- Tarjan publisher direct open timed out; its official abstract/metadata was searchable. A full-paper algorithm implementation review was not performed.
- Search snippets and live versioned docs can disagree. The cited retrieved body, source inspection, and future runtime verification are distinct evidence levels.
- No downloaded source archives, copied book/paper corpus, engine source hash verification, compiler invocation, runtime test, benchmark, code implementation, Git object, PR update, Page mutation, or durable publication was performed by this worker.
